note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 9252 Section 2 after export-chain next-hop unification (cabc8c511e / c2d7117d05): "If the BGP next hop is unchanged during the advertisement, the SRv6 Service TLVs, including any unrecognized Types of Sub-TLV and Sub-Sub-TLV, SHOULD be propagated further. In addition, all Reserved fields in the TLV, Sub-TLV, or Sub-Sub-TLV MUST be propagated unchanged." Both forward rails (forward_rs.go:reactorForwardRSSectionResult and reactor_api_forward.go:forwardUpdateCore) call applyEgressPrefixSIDNextHop after applyEgressNextHopIntent and applyEgressNextHopScope, leaving attribute 40 untouched whenever the final effective emitted next-hop entity equals the received entity. All three tagged tests (TestRFC9252EffectiveNextHopControlsServiceTLVs, TestPrefixSIDPropagationNextHop, TestRFC9252ReservedFieldsPropagatedUnchanged) were migrated from PeerSettings.NextHopMode to export-chain policychain.NextHopMode* / setExportNextHop* / attachExplicitNextHop and still assert exact byte-identical L3 and L2 Service TLVs including non-zero Reserved octets (TLV RESERVED 0xA5, Sub-TLV Reserved1 0x5A, Reserved2 0xC3) and unrecognized Sub-TLV 0xF0 / Sub-Sub-TLV 0xEE in actual cached and RS recipient Session output on unchanged, auto-already-self, explicit A-to-A, restoration, pair-trim, and mixed legacy-only cases, paired with changed-next-hop counter-controls.
